metadata.title: Manually Curated Well-Known EU Legislation Acronyms
metadata.description: Common acronyms for major EU laws that are not defined in official titles
metadata.note: These are informal but widely-used acronyms. Supplement to automatically extracted acronyms.

CRA.full_title: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 on horizontal cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements (Cyber Resilience Act)

eIDAS.full_title: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 on electronic identification and trust services for electronic transactions in the internal market
eIDAS.full_name: Electronic Identification, Authentication and Trust Services
